controls.source_trace: Account lookup -> verified destination -> token subject/purpose -> reset.
controls.controlled_verification: Use two controlled accounts/inbox sinks and track each recovery stage.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A success page is not evidence of token delivery, reset or account takeover.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Recipient, subject and purpose remain bound; unauthorized destination gets no recovery authority.

controls.source_trace: Allowed algorithm/key source -> signature -> issuer/audience/purpose/time -> caller.
controls.controlled_verification: Vary one claim/trust property in a local or explicitly controlled token fixture.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Readable JWT claims and unaccepted malformed tokens are not forgery.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Tokens outside the application contract reject on the actual protected path.

controls.source_trace: Anonymous session -> login/privilege change -> refresh/logout/reset -> server authority.
controls.controlled_verification: Compare controlled pre/post-transition sessions against the declared policy.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Stateless bounded lifetime and immediate revocation are different documented models.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Session behavior matches the chosen policy across refresh and alternate paths.

controls.source_trace: Primary login -> factor challenge -> recovery/fallback -> authenticated authority.
controls.controlled_verification: Check controlled branches and identify whether reset still requires the factor.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Password reset does not imply full takeover when a second factor remains effective.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Lower-assurance branches cannot bypass a required factor or bind it to the wrong identity.

controls.source_trace: Redirect/callback -> state/nonce -> provider subject -> local account linkage.
controls.controlled_verification: Use controlled provider identities and registered callbacks only.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Similar email display strings do not prove equivalent verified identity.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Federated response is bound to the intended session/provider/account and valid trust contract.

controls.source_trace: Attempt identity/source -> counter key/window -> delay/lockout -> recovery.
controls.controlled_verification: Inspect configuration or use a small agreed test-account request budget.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Do not spray credentials; a small timing sample is weak evidence.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Required throttling resists simple key bypass and avoids unintended real-user lockout.
